svg.title: AI-Powered WhatsApp Customer Service Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram: inbound WhatsApp channel via Evolution API, n8n main orchestrator with validation, lead upsert, message routing, audio transcription and a Redis buffer with debounce, an AI Agent with LLM, RAG retrieval, embeddings, calculator, MCP client and human-handoff tools, external Google Calendar tools behind an MCP server, a human support handoff, a persistence layer (PostgreSQL, Supabase pgvector, Supabase leads, Redis), an outbound response path, and a separate RAG ingestion pipeline from Google Drive into the Supabase vector store.
svg.text: Event-driven n8n orchestration · persistent conversational state · retrieval-augmented generation · MCP tools · human escalation
PERSISTENCE (state keyed by customer phone number)
